slice: Natural conversation round 40: praise ('you're amazing') and capability ('can you sing?') answered naturally, never 'no good answer on X'

replies.you're amazing: That's really kind of you — thank you.
replies.i love you: That's really kind of you — thank you.
replies.can you sing?: Honestly? I can't sing, dance, or move in the physical world — no body for that. But I can talk, think things through, and help with ideas.
replies.dance for me: Honestly? I can't sing, dance, or move in the physical world — no body for that. But I can talk, think things through, and help with ideas.

mechanism: praise/affection detector -> warm acceptance; capability detector -> honest 'no body for that' reply
